hints.stat.prob.simple: Probability = the ways it can happen ÷ all the possible outcomes. Simplify the fraction.
hints.stat.prob.compound: Two separate events together: multiply the probabilities. Expected count = probability × number of tries.
hints.stat.prob: Ways it can happen ÷ all outcomes. Two events together: multiply.

misconceptionMessages.stat.prob-part-part: Compare to all the outcomes, not just the other ones. The bottom of the fraction is the total.
misconceptionMessages.stat.prob-wrong-total: Count every possible outcome for the total.
misconceptionMessages.stat.prob-complement: Read again: it asks for NOT that. Count the outcomes that aren't it.
misconceptionMessages.stat.prob-multiplied: With one pick, "red or blue" adds: count the red and the blue marbles together.
misconceptionMessages.stat.prob-added: Two separate events both happening: multiply the probabilities, don't add.
misconceptionMessages.stat.expected-complement: That's how many times it wouldn't happen. Multiply the probability of the event by the number of tries.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Probability of one event
sections.objective: Find the probability of an event, of NOT the event, and of "this or that".
explain: Probability is a number from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain). When every outcome is equally likely, it's a fraction.
sections.key: Probability = the ways it can happen ÷ all the possible outcomes. NOT the event: count everything else.

sections.title: Two events, and expected counts
sections.objective: Find the probability of two separate events together, and how often to expect something.
explain: When two things happen separately (a coin and a number cube), the chance of both is smaller than either one alone.
sections.key: Both of two separate events: multiply the probabilities. Expected count = probability × number of tries.

worked.math: roll a cube 60 times: expect a 4?

sections.title: Putting it together
explain: Now the questions are mixed. One event or two?
sections.key: One event: ways ÷ all outcomes. Two separate events: multiply. Expected count: probability × tries.

worked.math: spinner with 4 equal parts (1 blue), and a coin
